{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA test orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_neg1_mask = df['customer_age'] == -1
print(f'Number of -1 values in customer_age: {age_neg1_mask.sum()}')

# Show cleaned revenue values
print('\nFirst 5 cleaned revenue values:')
print(df['revenue_clean'].head(5))"}
